spec.purpose: Measure completed phases on the qualified fused-PV1, compact-MoE1 and adaptive-OUT2 stack, retaining every artifact and numerical option from the uninstrumented q8192/out512 baseline. Only five completed profile flags and disabled marker filtering differ. Require all512 original GB10 IDs, callbacks and first logit within0.125. CK probability phase now includes native PV; the native-PV phase is an empty completion boundary. Nested and overlapping intervals are not additive; negative or nonfinite device timings are invalid. Instrumented TTFT is not a new performance baseline.

phase_analysis.ck_probability_stage_scope: Softmax and native PV are fused in probability_ms; approximate_pv_ms is an empty completion boundary. Do not compare either field alone with an unfused profile.

timing_scope: Same-artifact fused-PV, compact-MoE and adaptive-OUT stack with five profile options and marker filtering disabled. Linear core stages are disjoint internally; preceding projections are separate. CK completed phases are nested in full attention; its probability phase includes native PV and its approximate-PV phase is only an empty completion boundary; first lazy EXP initialization is outside the internal CK profile but remains included in outer full-attention and first-callback TTFT. Routed and shared MoE overlap. Dense correction excludes the matrix producer; coarse OUT includes preparation, producer, replay and conversion. Device-event negative/nonfinite values are preserved as invalid and excluded from totals. Instrumentation overhead remains; this is no retained-performance result.

decision.decision: Preserve the qualified fused-PV1, compact-MoE1 and adaptive-OUT2 stack and its uninstrumented24835.3024ms baseline. Current completed walls remain dominated by original scalar carry/correction work: CK QK3199.1137ms, exact PV1736.8099ms, linear recurrence3571.606ms, plus projection and MoE correction. Do not sum nested or overlapping phases, or treat this instrumented run as a performance comparison. The certified-grid scan shortcut is slower; graph repackaging and a dense scratch pool have insufficient measured potential. Investigate exact composition of fixed-grid K16 rounding maps as a broader arithmetic/dataflow replacement, beginning with independent integer proof and real-operand coverage. This is an unmeasured hypothesis and may be replaced by new evidence.
